```python
import pandas as pd
import libpysal
from libpysal.weights import W
from esda.moran import Moran

# Load dataset and adjacency matrix
df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/moran_global_2023_crime.csv")
adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Build spatial weights matrix from adjacency data
w = libpysal.weights.W.from_dataframe(adj_df, idVariable="id")

# Extract variable of interest (assuming column name 'value')
y = df["value"].values

# Calculate Moran's I
moran = Moran(y, w)

# Print results
print("Moran's I:", moran.I)
print("p-value:", moran.p_sim)
```
